title: Ingest edge: API & Firehose to S3
summary: HTTP ingest API plus our own Firehose-like buffering service that writes gzip NDJSON files into the raw bucket.
goal: Telemetry sent over HTTP lands as gzip NDJSON files in `stratum-raw`, partitioned by hour, with backpressure under load and no data loss on shutdown.
success_criteria: A producer can POST batches and gets per-record accept/reject results.
Firehose flushes on size or interval, whichever comes first, and keys sort by time.
Stopping Firehose with SIGTERM never loses accepted records.
A load generator can drive the edge at a chosen rate.
rust_learning_outcomes: axum routing, extractors and shared state
out_of_scope: TLS termination (assume a proxy in front)
